dataset: Official ALS classified-ground DGM current mosaic; bounded unstyled F32 scenery export
horizontal_crs: EPSG:32633 for original export; retained local source XY for terrain grid
vertical_datum: Official Austrian Gebrauchshöhen minus the same filtered road minimum as elevation-corrections.json. No separate median rebase.
attribution: Land Steiermark / GIS-Steiermark, ALS DGM. Modified by bounded numeric export, CRS transformation, bilinear resampling and relative datum subtraction.
coverage_note: Every point of the previous 215x177 local12m grid covered by valid source values; no extrapolation or DSM fallback. Previous scenery horizon/extent preserved.
method: Sample retained4m numeric classified-ground raster bilinearly onto unchanged12m local scenery lattice. The racing profile uses a separate2m source export and its documented2m noise filter. Existing20m near-road join remains; no terrain binary written by the source author.
grid_frame_note: Retained grid XY uses this original geographic projection scale. Materialization composes current provenance scene scale into XY origin/spacing only; source heights and vertical datum remain unchanged.
